recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14017; do not reintroduce retired core extension rows, and revisit only if a later work-group decision changes Questionnaire.item Quantity support or Quantity comparison guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-14017 was a Published FHIR-core STU3 change request resolved Persuasive. It asked for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/minValue to allow Quantity as a value because Quantity is an allowed questionnaire item answer type, with an implementation note acknowledging that Quantity comparisons can be hard.
initial_application: No explicit Git commit mentioning FHIR-14017 was found; Jira points to an SVN-era application. Current Git history shows the old core minValue extension row still lacked Quantity until 115e85b1ea, the FHIR-27914 implementation, changed it from date|dateTime|time|decimal|integer to date|dateTime|time|decimal|integer|Quantity.
additional_context: FHIR-14016 is the paired Published STU3 issue that removed instant from minValue because Questionnaire.item does not allow instant. FHIR-27914 later aligned minValue and maxValue for R5 by adding Quantity to both and removing instant from maxValue; that related issue is already represented on the combined branch. The minValue/maxValue extension definitions were subsequently moved out of core by dd468d4f17 and now live in the FHIR Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current Extension Pack StructureDefinition-minValue.xml allows Quantity on Extension.value[x], current core ElementDefinition.minValue[x] includes Quantity and explains canonical Quantity minima, and the active core element-extensions spreadsheet no longer contains a minValue extension row to edit.

related_jiras.note: Paired Published STU3 decision that removed instant from minValue because Questionnaire.item does not allow instant.
Later Published R5 decision that applied Quantity support to both minValue and maxValue and removed instant from maxValue; already audited on the combined branch.
